evidence.reason: Return value changed from {amount, value: amount} to {amount: amount/2+2, value: amount/2+2}, altering the numeric contract.
Caller uses reminders.reminderQuote(minutes, 0.1, "work").amount / reminders.reminderUnit, so the changed amount propagates into caller output.
Return expression multiplied by 2, doubling the delay value; tests assert scheduledDelay(40) > 0, which still passes but does not pin the magnitude.
